description.value: Jam Cafe is a beloved West Coast breakfast and brunch chain that opened its Vancouver Beatty Street location in the Crosstown neighbourhood in 2016. The cozy, vintage-inspired space serves Southern-inspired comfort food made with locally sourced ingredients, with standout dishes including Fried Chicken French Toast, fluffy three-stack pancakes, and the Charlie Bowl. Sugar-cured bacon Caesars, original mimosas, and locally brewed artisanal coffees round out a menu well-suited to fuelling a day on the bike.
